booking.docTitle: Booking Websites for Salons, Clinics & Small Hotels | Likwiid
booking.heroTitle: Websites with online booking for salons, clinics, and small hotels.
booking.heroSubtitle: Your customers want to book at 11pm from their phone. If your website can't take that booking, they move on to one that can. We build simple, fast websites where customers book and pay online, and you keep every booking commission-free.
booking.painPoint1: Customers can only book by phone, so evening and weekend requests go to whoever answers first.
booking.painPoint2: Marketplace apps take a commission on every booking that should have been yours.
booking.painPoint3: No-shows cost you hours because nothing collects a deposit or sends a reminder.
booking.painPoint4: Your only web presence is an Instagram page, so you never own your customer list.
booking.feature1Desc: Customers see your actual availability and pick a time slot themselves. No back-and-forth calls, no waiting for a callback.
booking.feature2Desc: Take a card deposit at booking time so no-shows stop costing you money. We work with the payment providers available in your country.
booking.feature3Desc: WhatsApp or email reminders go out before every appointment, without anyone on your team lifting a finger.
booking.feature4Desc: Your own domain, your own customer list, your own brand. No commissions to a marketplace, no platform lock-in.
booking.proofPara1: We designed and built a complete court-booking platform: customers browse available slots, book, and pay from their phone, and the owners manage everything from an admin dashboard. The same building blocks work for salon appointments, clinic visits, and hotel room reservations.
booking.proofPara2: What this means for your business: customers book and pay online instead of calling or sending a DM and hoping someone answers.

direct.docTitle: Likwiid Direct, a Direct Booking Engine for Small Stays | Likwiid
direct.heroTitle: Bookings that flow straight to you.
direct.heroSubtitle: Likwiid Direct is a direct booking engine for small stays and experiences. No commission, no middleman, no lock-in. You keep your domain, your payment account and your guest list.
direct.demoNote: Quinta Likwiid and Atelier Likwiid are fictional. They exist so you can click through the exact engine we would build for you. The checkout is simulated and no payment is taken.
direct.feature1Desc: A tasting for two, an airport transfer, an extra night. Guests tick what they want and watch the total and the deposit update in front of them. This is the part no small booking widget does well, and it is the part we built first.
direct.feature2Title: A deposit, not the full amount
direct.feature2Desc: Most small properties already ask for 20 or 30 percent by bank transfer. Likwiid Direct takes the same deposit by card, at the exact moment the guest decides, and the balance stays payable on arrival.
direct.feature3Title: It lives inside the site you already have
direct.feature3Desc: One script tag and one div on any WordPress, Wix or hand-built site. No rebuild, no migration. Your website stays yours and the bookings come straight to you.
direct.feature4Desc: Every step, every label and every price in the language the guest picks. Nothing half translated and nothing leaking internal labels.
direct.ownership: Booking platforms bring reach, and they charge for it: commission on every stay, their brand between you and your guest, their rules. Likwiid Direct is the other lane. Your domain, your payment account, your guest list. We build it, you own it.
direct.scarcity: This engine is not running anyone's bookings yet. We would like yours to be first, at a reference price in exchange for showing the finished work. And if you would rather keep bookings personal and manual, that is a fine way to run a business, and this product is not for you.
direct.demoOverlayNote: Fictional property, simulated checkout, no payment is taken.
direct.demoPreviewAlt: Preview of the Likwiid Direct booking flow
direct.syncBody: Likwiid Direct imports the busy dates from the calendars you already use. Any platform that can export an iCal feed works, and those dates close here automatically. It also exports a feed for each unit, so a direct booking closes the date everywhere else you list. In the live demo the synced calendar is sample data.
direct.requestBody: Not every owner wants a booking to confirm itself. Likwiid Direct also runs in request mode, where a visitor picks what they want and sends it to you. Nothing is booked and nothing is charged. You confirm, or suggest another time, exactly as you do now. Same page, same calendar, no payment step at all.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.collectBody: When you use our contact form, we collect the information you provide: your name, email address, company name (if provided), and message content. We do not collect any information automatically beyond what is strictly necessary for the website to function.
privacy.useBody: We use the information you submit through our contact form solely to respond to your inquiry and discuss potential projects. We will not send you marketing communications unless you have explicitly opted in to receive them.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell, trade, or share your personal information with third parties. Your data stays with us and is used exclusively for the purpose it was provided.
privacy.cookiesBody: We only use essential cookies. Specifically, we store your theme preference (light or dark mode) in your browser's localStorage. We do not use any tracking cookies or third-party cookies.
privacy.analyticsBody: We use privacy-friendly analytics that do not use cookies and do not track personal data. No personally identifiable information is collected through our analytics, and your browsing activity is not tracked across websites.
privacy.retentionBody: Contact form submissions are retained for legitimate business purposes, such as maintaining records of client communications and project discussions. We keep this data only as long as necessary for these purposes.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of any personal data we hold about you. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at
privacy.updatesBody: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated revision date. We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please reach out at
